title: Produce an allowlisted request summary that never retains passcodes or game choices
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement safeRequestSummary exactly as frozen in section B090 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Inspect only own data descriptors for type/requestId and return a fixed kind allowlist plus a bounded ASCII requestId1–64 matching[A-Za-z0-9_-]. Do not traverse payload/intent or coerce arbitrary values. Summaries intentionally omit candidate, option, target, room code, alias, passcode, seed, raw request, and subject identity; missing/unsafe descriptors become unknown/null.
acceptance: All supported type names preserve only the approved kind and safe request identity.
A request carrying passcode, operation option or role properties never serializes those values in summary.
Getter/proxy failures and invalid IDs/types return unknown/null without invoking user getters or throwing raw exceptions.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
